## Change

What problem does this fix, and what can the user or maintainer do now? Link the issue or feature task when applicable.

## Review and verification

Identify the tested candidate. Give the working directory, command and exit status, or reproducible manual steps. State what happened on the affected path and link evidence. Include a demonstration for a visible change.

## Open items

List any failed or pending acceptance criteria, outstanding findings, required review or release decision.
